verses.english: “There are two conditions for the arising of right view.

verses.pali: Parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro.
verses.english: The voice of another and rational application of mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two conditions for the arising of right view.”
